title: Record a payment against an invoice
aliases: customer paid me, how do I record it
body:
Use this when a customer pays by bank transfer, cash or cheque outside Harbour.

1. Go to **Invoices** and open the invoice.
2. Select **Record payment**.
3. Enter the **Amount**, **Payment date** and **Method**.
4. Add a reference such as the transfer number in **Notes** if you like.
5. Select **Save payment**.

The invoice status updates to **Paid** or **Part paid**.

title: Record a part payment
aliases: customer paid only some of the invoice
body:
1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select **Record payment**.
3. Change the **Amount** to the portion received. Harbour fills in the full balance by default.
4. Choose the **Payment date** and **Method**.
5. Select **Save payment**.

The invoice shows **Part paid** and the remaining **Balance due** is updated.

title: Delete a payment entered by mistake
body:
Only payments recorded manually can be deleted. Card payments must be refunded instead.

1. Open the invoice and scroll to **Payment history**.
2. Select the three dots next to the payment.
3. Choose **Delete payment**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Delete**.

The invoice balance and status are recalculated straight away.

title: Change the date of a payment
aliases: edit when the payment was received
body:
1. Go to **Payments** and find the payment using the search box.
2. Select the payment to open it.
3. Select **Edit**.
4. Change the **Payment date**.
5. Select **Save changes**.

Changing the date can move the payment into a different reporting period, so check your reports afterwards.

title: Connect a card payment gateway
body:
You need to be an account **Owner** or **Admin** to do this.

1. Go to **Settings** and select **Payment gateways**.
2. Select **Connect** next to your gateway.
3. Sign in to the gateway and approve the connection.
4. Choose which currencies to accept.
5. Select **Save**.

Your invoices now show a **Pay now** button to customers.

title: Turn off online payments for one invoice
aliases: disable card payment on an invoice
body:
1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Under **Payment options**, clear **Allow online payment**.
4. Select **Save**.

The customer will see your bank details only. Other invoices are not affected.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Add bank details to your invoices
aliases: put my BSB and account number on invoices
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Payment details**.
2. Enter your **Account name**, **BSB** and **Account number**.
3. Add any extra wording, such as a payment reference, in **Instructions**.
4. Select **Save**.

The details appear in the footer of every new invoice that uses your default template.

title: Set default payment terms
aliases: how long customers have to pay
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Invoice defaults**.
2. Under **Payment terms**, choose an option such as **Net 14** or **Net 30**.
3. Select **Save**.

New invoices use these terms. Existing invoices keep their current due date, and you can still change the due date on any single invoice.

title: Refund a card payment
aliases: give the money back to customer's card
body:
Refunds go back to the original card and usually take 5 to 10 business days to appear.

1. Go to **Payments** and open the card payment.
2. Select **Refund**.
3. Enter the amount to return. You can refund less than the full payment.
4. Choose a **Reason**.
5. Select **Confirm refund**.

title: Import a bank statement to match payments
body:
1. Go to **Payments** and select **Import**.
2. Choose **Bank statement (CSV)** and upload your file.
3. Match the columns for **Date**, **Amount** and **Description**.
4. Review the suggested matches and untick any that are wrong.
5. Select **Apply payments**.

Unmatched lines stay in **Needs review** so you can match them by hand.

title: Export payments to CSV
body:
1. Go to **Payments**.
2. Use the **Date range** and **Method** filters to narrow the list.
3. Select **Export** and choose **CSV**.
4. Open the file from your downloads when it is ready.

The export includes the customer name, invoice number, amount, method and reference.

title: Save a card on a customer's profile
body:
The customer must have approved card storage, either at checkout or by an emailed request.

1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select the **Payments** tab.
3. Select **Request card**.
4. Choose the billing contact to email.

Once the customer completes the form, the card appears under **Saved cards**.

title: Remove a saved card from a customer
body:
1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select the **Payments** tab.
3. Next to the card under **Saved cards**, select **Remove**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Remove card**.

Any recurring invoices set to charge this card will switch to emailing the invoice instead.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Apply a customer's prepayment to an invoice
aliases: apply credit on account to invoice
body:
1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select **Apply credit**.
3. Pick the prepayment or overpayment from the list.
4. Enter the amount to apply.
5. Select **Apply**.

Any unused amount stays on the customer's account.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Add a card surcharge to invoices
aliases: add a surcharge for credit card
body:
Check your local rules on surcharging before turning this on.

1. Go to **Settings** and select **Payment gateways**.
2. Select **Surcharge settings**.
3. Turn on **Add surcharge** and enter a percentage.
4. Select **Save**.

The surcharge appears as a separate line when the customer chooses to pay by card.

title: Send a payment receipt
body:
1. Go to **Payments** and open the payment.
2. Select **Send receipt**.
3. Check the billing contact's email address, or add another.
4. Select **Send**.

Harbour attaches a PDF receipt. Card payments also send one automatically.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Send a payment reminder
body:
1. Go to **Invoices** and open the unpaid invoice.
2. Select **Send reminder**.
3. Pick a reminder template, such as **Friendly nudge** or **Final notice**.
4. Review the message and edit it if needed.
5. Select **Send**.

The reminder is logged in the invoice **Activity** list.

title: Set up automatic payment reminders
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Reminders**.
2. Turn on **Automatic reminders**.
3. Select **Add reminder** and choose when it is sent, for example **3 days before due** or **7 days after due**.
4. Choose a template for each reminder.
5. Select **Save**.

Reminders stop as soon as an invoice is paid.

title: Pause reminders on one invoice
aliases: don't remind customer about this one
body:
Use this when you have agreed a payment date with the customer.

1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select **More**, then **Reminder settings**.
3. Turn off **Send automatic reminders**.
4. Select **Save**.

You can turn them back on at any time.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Pause reminders for a customer
aliases: stop all reminders to a client
body:
1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Under **Preferences**, clear **Send payment reminders**.
4. Select **Save**.

This applies to all of the customer's invoices, including future ones.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Edit a reminder email template
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Reminders**.
2. Open the **Templates** tab.
3. Select the template you want to change.
4. Edit the **Subject** and **Message**. Use fields such as **{customer_name}** and **{amount_due}**.
5. Select **Save template**.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: View all overdue invoices
body:
1. Go to **Invoices**.
2. Select the **Overdue** tab.
3. Sort by **Days overdue** to see the oldest first.

Use the search box to narrow the list to one customer.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Change an invoice's due date
body:
1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Change the **Due date**.
4. Select **Save**.

If the new date is in the future, an overdue invoice goes back to **Awaiting payment** and reminders restart from the new date.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Set up a payment plan on an overdue invoice
body:
1. Open the overdue invoice.
2. Select **More**, then **Payment plan**.
3. Choose the number of instalments and the first due date.
4. Review the schedule.
5. Select **Create plan**.

Each instalment gets its own due date and reminder.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Add a late fee to an overdue invoice
body:
1. Open the overdue invoice.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Select **Add line item** and enter your late fee description and amount.
4. Select **Save**.

To add the fee automatically, go to **Settings**, select **Reminders**, and turn on **Late fees**.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Add a note after calling about an overdue invoice
aliases: record a phone call with customer
write down what the customer said
body:
Notes are internal and are never shown to the customer.

1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select the **Notes** tab.
3. Type your note, such as the date the customer promised to pay.
4. Select **Add note**.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Write off an unpayable invoice
body:
1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select **More**, then **Write off**.
3. Enter a **Reason**.
4. Select **Confirm write-off**.

The invoice status changes to **Written off** and reminders stop. The amount appears in your **Bad debts** report.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Change who reminders are sent from
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Reminders**.
2. Select **Sender details**.
3. Enter the **From name** and **Reply-to email**.
4. Select **Save**.
5. Check the confirmation email sent to the new address.

The new reply-to address is used once it is confirmed.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Update a billing contact's email address
body:
Reminders and invoices are sent to the customer's billing contacts.

1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select the **Contacts** tab.
3. Select the billing contact.
4. Change the **Email** and select **Save**.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Add a billing contact to a customer
aliases: add another person to receive invoices
body:
1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select the **Contacts** tab.
3. Select **Add contact**.
4. Enter the name and **Email**, and tick **Receives invoices**.
5. Select **Save**.

Every billing contact receives invoices and reminders.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Update a customer's phone number
body:
1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Change the number in the **Phone** field.
4. Select **Save**.

To change a billing contact's number instead, open the **Contacts** tab and edit the contact.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Create a recurring invoice
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and select **New recurring invoice**.
2. Choose the customer.
3. Add your line items.
4. Under **Schedule**, choose how often to invoice and the **Start date**.
5. Select **Save**.

Harbour creates each invoice on the schedule you set.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Turn an existing invoice into a recurring one
body:
1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select **More**, then **Make recurring**.
3. Choose the frequency and the **Next invoice date**.
4. Select **Create recurring invoice**.

The original invoice stays as it is.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Pause a recurring invoice
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **Pause**.
3. Choose a **Resume date**, or leave it blank to resume manually.
4. Select **Confirm**.

No invoices are created while it is paused, and missed invoices are not back-filled.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Cancel a recurring invoice
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **More**, then **End schedule**.
3. Pick the **End date** and select **Confirm**.

Invoices already created are not changed. An ended schedule can be viewed under **Ended**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Skip the next recurring invoice
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Under **Upcoming invoices**, find the next one.
3. Select **Skip**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Skip invoice**.

The schedule continues as normal after the skipped date.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Change how often a recurring invoice is sent
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Under **Schedule**, choose a new **Frequency**.
4. Check the **Next invoice date**.
5. Select **Save**.

The change applies from the next invoice.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Change the amount on a recurring invoice
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Change the **Unit price** or **Quantity** on the line items.
4. Select **Save**.

Only future invoices use the new amount. Invoices already sent keep the old one.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Set an end date for a recurring invoice
aliases: stop after a number of invoices
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Under **Ends**, choose **On a date** or **After a number of invoices**.
4. Enter the date or number.
5. Select **Save**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Send recurring invoices automatically
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Under **When created**, choose **Approve and email**.
4. Select **Save**.

If you prefer to check each invoice, choose **Save as draft** instead.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Review recurring invoices saved as drafts
aliases: where do draft recurring invoices go
body:
1. Go to **Invoices** and select the **Drafts** tab.
2. Filter by **Source**, then choose **Recurring**.
3. Open a draft and check the details.
4. Select **Approve and send**.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Charge a saved card on a recurring invoice
aliases: bill card on file each month
body:
The customer must already have a saved card.

1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Under **Payment**, turn on **Charge saved card**.
4. Choose the card.
5. Select **Save**.

If the charge fails, Harbour emails the invoice and tells you under **Notifications**.

title: See upcoming recurring invoices
aliases: what will be billed next month
body:
1. Go to **Recurring**.
2. Select the **Upcoming** tab.
3. Pick a date range using the **Next 30 days** menu.

Each row shows the customer, the date and the expected amount.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Change the customer on a recurring invoice
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Select the current customer name and choose a different **Customer**.
4. Select **Save**.

Future invoices go to the new customer's billing contacts.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Add a purchase order number to a recurring invoice
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Enter the number in **Reference**.
4. Select **Save**.

The reference is printed on each new invoice.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Delete a recurring invoice schedule
body:
Deleting removes the schedule only. Invoices it created are kept.

1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **More**, then **Delete**.
3. Select **Delete schedule** to confirm.

If you may need it later, end the schedule instead so you can still view it.

title: Copy a recurring invoice for another customer
body:
1. Go to **Recurring** and open the schedule.
2. Select **More**, then **Duplicate**.
3. Choose the new **Customer**.
4. Adjust the dates if needed and select **Save**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Create a credit note
body:
1. Go to **Credit notes** and select **New credit note**.
2. Choose the customer.
3. Add line items and amounts to credit.
4. Select **Approve**.

The credit note appears on the customer's account and can be applied to an invoice or refunded.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Create a credit note from an invoice
body:
1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select **More**, then **Create credit note**.
3. Remove any lines you do not want to credit, or change the quantities.
4. Select **Approve**.

The credit note is linked to the invoice.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Apply a credit note to an invoice
body:
1. Go to **Credit notes** and open the credit note.
2. Select **Apply to invoice**.
3. Tick the invoice and enter the amount.
4. Select **Apply**.

Any leftover amount stays available on the credit note.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Record a refund paid by bank transfer
body:
Use this after you have sent the money yourself.

1. Go to **Credit notes** and open the credit note.
2. Select **Record refund**.
3. Enter the **Amount**, **Date** and **Method**.
4. Select **Save refund**.

The credit note balance is reduced by the amount refunded.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Void a credit note
body:
A credit note can only be voided if nothing has been applied or refunded against it.

1. Open the credit note from **Credit notes**.
2. Select **More**, then **Void**.
3. Select **Confirm**.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Void an invoice
body:
Voiding keeps the invoice number on record but sets the balance to zero.

1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select **More**, then **Void**.
3. Enter a **Reason**.
4. Select **Void invoice**.

If the customer has paid, create a credit note and refund instead.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Delete a draft invoice
aliases: remove an invoice that was never sent
body:
1. Go to **Invoices** and select the **Drafts** tab.
2. Open the draft.
3. Select **More**, then **Delete**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Delete draft**.

Only drafts can be deleted. Sent invoices must be voided.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Email a credit note to a customer
aliases: customer wants a copy of credit note
body:
1. Go to **Credit notes** and open the credit note.
2. Select **Send**.
3. Check the recipients and edit the message.
4. Select **Send credit note**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Edit a credit note before it is approved
body:
1. Go to **Credit notes** and select the **Drafts** tab.
2. Open the credit note.
3. Make your changes to the lines, dates or reference.
4. Select **Save**.

Approved credit notes cannot be edited. Void it and create a new one.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Refund an overpayment
body:
1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select the **Account** tab and find the **Overpayment** line.
3. Select **Refund**.
4. Enter the amount and choose **Card** or **Bank transfer**.
5. Select **Confirm**.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: See credit notes that have not been used
body:
1. Go to **Credit notes**.
2. Select the **Open** tab.
3. Sort by **Remaining credit** to see the largest balances first.

Select any row to apply or refund it.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Export credit notes to CSV
body:
1. Go to **Credit notes**.
2. Filter by date or status.
3. Select **Export**, then **CSV**.

The file lists the number, customer, date, total and remaining credit.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Change the credit note numbering
aliases: start numbering at a different number
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Numbering**.
2. Under **Credit notes**, change the **Prefix** or **Next number**.
3. Select **Save**.

Numbers already issued do not change.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot. If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Add a reason to a credit note
body:
1. Open the credit note from **Credit notes**.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Choose a **Reason**, or select **Custom** to type your own.
4. Select **Save**.

The reason is printed on the credit note PDF.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Add an internal note to a credit note
body:
1. Open the credit note from **Credit notes**.
2. Select the **Notes** tab.
3. Type your note.
4. Select **Add note**.

Customers never see internal notes.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Cancel a pending card refund
body:
You can only cancel a refund while its status is **Pending**.

1. Go to **Payments** and select the **Refunds** tab.
2. Open the pending refund.
3. Select **Cancel refund**.
4. Select **Confirm**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Run a sales report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Sales**.
2. Choose a **Date range**.
3. Group by **Month**, **Customer** or **Item** using the **Group by** menu.
4. Select **Run report**.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot. If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Export the aged receivables report
aliases: who owes me and for how long
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Aged receivables**.
2. Pick an **As at** date.
3. Select **Run report**.
4. Select **Export** and choose **CSV** or **PDF**.

Balances are grouped as current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Export your invoice list to CSV
body:
1. Go to **Invoices**.
2. Apply any filters, such as **Status** or **Date range**.
3. Select **Export** and choose **CSV**.
4. Open the file when your download finishes.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Export your customer list to CSV
aliases: get client list into a spreadsheet
body:
1. Go to **Customers**.
2. Select **Export**.
3. Choose **CSV** and tick the fields to include, such as **Phone** and **Billing contacts**.
4. Select **Download**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Import customers from a CSV file
body:
1. Go to **Customers** and select **Import**.
2. Download the sample file if you need the format.
3. Upload your CSV and match each column to a Harbour field.
4. Review the preview and select **Import customers**.

Rows with an existing customer name are updated rather than duplicated.

title: View a tax summary report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Tax summary**.
2. Choose the tax period and the **Basis**, either **Accrual** or **Cash**.
3. Select **Run report**.

Use **Export** to save a copy for your accountant.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Run a statement for one customer
aliases: what does customer owe in total
body:
1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select **Statement**.
3. Choose the date range.
4. Select **Send** to email it, or **Download PDF**.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when. Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Schedule a report to be emailed
aliases: email me the aged receivables each Monday
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and run the report you want.
2. Select **Schedule**.
3. Choose the frequency, time and recipients.
4. Select **Save schedule**.

Manage scheduled reports under **Reports**, then **Scheduled**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Save a report with your filters
body:
1. Run the report with the filters you want.
2. Select **Save view**.
3. Name the view and select **Save**.

Your saved views appear under **Reports**, then **My views**.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot. If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Run a payments received report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Payments received**.
2. Choose a **Date range**.
3. Group by **Method** or **Customer**.
4. Select **Run report**.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**. Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: See the history of an invoice
body:
1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select the **Activity** tab.
3. Scroll to view each email, view, payment and edit with its date and user.

Use this to confirm a customer has viewed an invoice.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Export a recurring revenue report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Recurring revenue**.
2. Choose the number of months to forecast.
3. Select **Run report**.
4. Select **Export** to download a CSV.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Run a bad debts report
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Bad debts**.
2. Choose a **Date range**.
3. Select **Run report**.

The report lists each written-off invoice with the date, customer and reason.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot. If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Run a report in another currency
aliases: see totals in my base currency
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and open the report.
2. Open the **Currency** menu.
3. Choose **Base currency** to convert everything, or pick a single currency.
4. Select **Run report**.

Amounts are converted using the rate on each invoice.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Download a report as a PDF
body:
1. Run the report you need.
2. Select **Export**.
3. Choose **PDF**.
4. Save the file or print it from your browser.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when. Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: See your top customers by revenue
body:
1. Go to **Reports** and select **Sales**.
2. Set **Group by** to **Customer**.
3. Choose a **Date range**.
4. Select **Run report**, then sort by **Total**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Update your business name and address
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Business details**.
2. Edit the **Business name**, **Address** or **Tax number**.
3. Select **Save**.

Changes appear on new invoices. Existing invoices keep the details they were sent with.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Upload your logo to invoices
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Templates**.
2. Open your default template.
3. Under **Logo**, select **Upload** and choose a PNG or JPG file.
4. Select **Save**.

A logo at least 400 pixels wide gives the sharpest result.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Change the colours on your invoice template
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Templates**.
2. Open the template.
3. Under **Style**, choose an **Accent colour** or enter a hex code.
4. Select **Save**.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Create a new invoice template
aliases: new template for a different brand
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Templates**.
2. Select **New template**.
3. Name the template and choose a starting layout.
4. Adjust the sections, colours and footer.
5. Select **Save**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Duplicate an invoice template
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Templates**.
2. Select the three dots next to the template.
3. Choose **Duplicate**.
4. Rename the copy and select **Save**.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot. If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Set the default invoice template
aliases: choose which template new invoices use
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Templates**.
2. Select the three dots next to the template you want.
3. Choose **Set as default**.

You can still pick another template on any individual invoice.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Use a different template for one customer
body:
1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Under **Invoice template**, choose the template.
4. Select **Save**.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when. Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Edit the email that sends with an invoice
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Email templates**.
2. Select **Invoice**.
3. Edit the **Subject** and **Message**.
4. Select **Save**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time. If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.

title: Add a footer message to invoices
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Templates**.
2. Open the template.
3. Type your text in **Footer**.
4. Select **Save**.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot. If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Change the invoice numbering
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Numbering**.
2. Under **Invoices**, change the **Prefix** or **Next number**.
3. Select **Save**.

Harbour will not let you reuse a number that already exists.

If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Invite a team member
aliases: add an employee to the account
body:
Only an **Owner** or **Admin** can invite users.

1. Go to **Settings** and select **Users**.
2. Select **Invite user**.
3. Enter their email and choose a **Role**.
4. Select **Send invite**.

The invite link is valid for 7 days.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Change a team member's role
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Users**.
2. Select the user.
3. Choose a new **Role**, such as **Admin**, **Standard** or **Read only**.
4. Select **Save**.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Remove a team member
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Users**.
2. Select the user.
3. Select **Remove user**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Remove**.

Their past activity stays in the invoice history.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot. If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Change your login email
aliases: I changed jobs and need a new login
body:
1. Select your name at the bottom of the left menu, then **My profile**.
2. Enter your new **Email**.
3. Select **Save**.
4. Open the confirmation email and select the button inside it.

You will keep signing in with the old address until you confirm.

title: Reset your password
body:
1. On the sign-in page, select **Forgot password**.
2. Enter your email and select **Send reset link**.
3. Open the email and select **Choose new password**.
4. Enter and confirm your new password.

If you are already signed in, go to **My profile** and select **Change password**.

title: Download a backup of your account data
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Account**.
2. Select **Export all data**.
3. Choose the data to include, then select **Request export**.

We email a download link when it is ready. It expires after 48 hours.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: Add a note to a customer
aliases: write a comment on a client
body:
1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select the **Notes** tab.
3. Type your note.
4. Select **Add note**.

Notes are visible to your team only.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot. If you cannot see this option, ask an account Owner or Admin to check your role under **Settings**, then **Users**.

title: Archive a customer
aliases: hide a client I no longer bill
body:
Customers with invoices cannot be deleted, but they can be archived.

1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer.
2. Select **More**, then **Archive**.
3. Select **Archive customer**.

Archived customers are hidden from lists. Find them with the **Archived** filter and select **Restore** to bring them back.

title: Merge duplicate customers
body:
1. Go to **Customers** and open the customer to keep.
2. Select **More**, then **Merge**.
3. Choose the duplicate customer.
4. Select **Merge customers**.

The duplicate's invoices, contacts and notes move to the customer you kept.

Your changes are recorded in the account **Audit log**, so your team can see who made them and when.

title: Change your default currency
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Invoice defaults**.
2. Choose a **Default currency**.
3. Select **Save**.

This applies to new invoices only. Existing invoices keep their currency.

Need to undo this later? You can come back to the same screen and change it again at any time.

title: See which reminders were sent for an invoice
aliases: did the customer get a reminder
body:
1. Open the invoice from **Invoices**.
2. Select the **Activity** tab.
3. Select the **Reminders** filter to see each reminder with its date and recipient.

A reminder that bounced is marked **Failed**, so you can fix the billing contact's email and resend it.

If something looks wrong afterwards, contact Harbour Support from **Help** and include a screenshot.
